title: Uniform Simultaneous Bands for Quantile Treatment Effects on the Treated under Copula Stability
banked_reason: Sound finite-support QTT correspondence and honest band with full-GKM impossibility frontier, but positive mixed-law inference remains only an outer band; sharp optimized projection and functional convergence are open, capping the package at subfield.
gap_reasons: positive mixed-law inference remains an outer band: sharp optimized projection and functional convergence are open
The projected paper score is constrained by that mixed-law gap and by the absence of an implemented projection or worked application demonstrating practical gains.
proof_attempt_summary: The run derived a sharp completed-QTT correspondence and a finite-sample honest simultaneous projection band on fixed known finite support, together with contact and moving-atom adaptation impossibility results that transfer to the full GKM class. The rubric and mathematics panels found the package sound, but the field-level positive claim did not close: general mixed-law inference is only an outer band, with sharp optimized projection and functional convergence still open.
tldr: For the published two-period GKM model, exact control-rank ties prevent a uniformly honest simultaneous QTT band from adapting to the equality stratum: a contiguous positive perturbation reopens a fixed-width interval. Moving atoms separately prevent shrinking whole-rank supremum excess width, even with separated control ranks. Explicit finite and genuinely mixed rationalizing laws put these converse results inside the full published model. On each fixed finite support, the sharp completed-QTT correspondence has an equality-aware construction and a finite-sample honest projected band; a separated class has matched \(n^{-1/2}\) integrated excess-width bounds. A bounded mixed-law outer band is honest, while sharp optimized mixed projection remains open.
gap: GKM identification covers discrete and mixed outcomes but has no formal simultaneous inference theory. Generic DF inversion does not preserve joint GKM feasibility. CallawayLi2019 point-identifies QTT under a different three-period panel/change-copula model, while the nearest discrete QTT-bound model is non-nested and excludes the exact ties at issue.
fill: The project seeks an explicit observable-to-latent finite rationalization, an equality-aware projection with uniform coverage, a corrected two-regime contact experiment and one-sided adaptation lower bound, an independent moving-atom impossibility, and matched integrated-width rates on an observable separated class. It includes a safe mixed-law outer band but no unrestricted supremum-shrinkage promise.
